name: GM CCA - Chicago Parts Distribution Center, Bolingbrook IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: GM-operated parts DC (404k sq ft, opened 2001) on Remington Blvd. The truck yard wraps the entire south face and is enclosed by a chain-link perimeter fence (clearly visible along the east edge in z19/z20 imagery). The truck drive enters/exits the fenced south yard at the SE corner off the cul-de-sac service drive. Controlled entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth could be confirmed at the SE yard entrance. 2018 Street View of the access road is heavily screened by a grassy/tree buffer and the yard entrance is set well back. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated/fenced truck yard with no confirmable manned booth -> set true (kiosk/app check-in implied) at low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door bank runs the full ~400 ft+ south face of the building with trailers backed in; yellow dock-door markings visible on the wall in z20 imagery. Estimated ~55 doors -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two to three rows of parked drop trailers fill the south yard south of the dock apron; well over 50 trailer positions -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated paved trailer-storage yard south of the dock apron, separate from the active dock line, holding multiple long rows of trailers.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single continuous dock face on the south wall only (north side is roof + loop road, no docks) -> shipping and receiving share one dock bank.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single fenced truck-yard access at the SE corner serves both in and out movements.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved south yard and a deep gate-to-dock approach leave ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from the SE yard entrance to the dock face can stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved holding area inside the fenced yard before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; this Remington Blvd logistics park is served entirely by truck.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Modern logistics/distribution park in the Bolingbrook (SW Chicago metro) industrial corridor off I-55 -> Urban.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Honest overhead estimate (~110) from row counts in the south yard; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~404k sq ft building (~9 acre footprint) plus the south truck yard and buffer; fenced operational parcel ~20 acres (perimeter polygon estimate).
